feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: Police given more time to question two men re-arrested in RAF Fairford investigation
articles.summary: Two men who were re-arrested as part of an investigation into a suspected terror plot near RAF Fairford can be held for up to seven days after police were given more time to question them.

articles.title: Paedophile who spiked baby's bottle with vodka before abuse jailed
articles.summary: A paedophile who spiked a baby's bottle with vodka before molesting her has been jailed for 12 years.

articles.title: Websites across Europe taken down - as critical software update issued
articles.summary: Government and business websites across Europe were taken down in a bid to protect organisations after a critical software update was issued over vulnerabilities in programming language.

articles.title: Man forced to pay shooting victim, age 9, in first-of-its-kind compensation
articles.summary: A man who was found guilty of his role in a gangland shooting that left a nine-year-old girl with a bullet lodged in her brain has been ordered to pay her compensation.

articles.title: More arrests made over death of Manchester woman
articles.summary: Three more people have been arrested over the death of Alisha Samuels in Manchester.

articles.title: Man punched Jewish woman in the face as she pushed baby in pram, court hears
articles.summary: A man accused of assaulting three Jewish women allegedly punched one of them in the face while she was pushing her daughter in a pram, a court heard.

articles.title: Critical incident at NHS trust ends but patients still face 'long waits'
articles.summary: A critical incident at a NHS Trust has ended after the number of people waiting for assessment in A&E "dropped significantly" - but hospital bosses warned patients still face "long waits".

articles.title: Jailed former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson accused of rape inside Parliament - reports
articles.summary: Police are investigating former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson over an allegation that he raped a woman in the Houses of Parliament, the PA news agency reports.

articles.title: Teacher struck off after 'low-cut crop top' comment to schoolgirl
articles.summary: A former teacher has been struck off for telling a pupil he would attend a school production of Grease if she was wearing a "low-cut crop top and tight trousers".

articles.title: Boy, 16, found guilty of attempted murder after stabbing girl at school
articles.summary: A 16-year-old boy has been found guilty of attempted murder after stabbing a 15-year-old girl in the back at school.
